steps.name: 1-sw-registration
steps.eval: (async function(){ if(!navigator.serviceWorker) return JSON.stringify({supported:false}); var reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration(); var keys = await caches.keys(); return JSON.stringify({supported:true, hasReg: !!reg, scope: reg && reg.scope, controller: !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller, controllerUrl: navigator.serviceWorker.controller && navigator.serviceWorker.controller.scriptURL, caches: keys}); })()

steps.name: 2-shell-assets
steps.eval: (async function(){ var out={}; for (const u of ['/sw.js','/js/nest-ui.js','/css/nest.css','/libs/radix-colors/colors.css']) { try { var r = await fetch(u, {cache:'no-store'}); out[u] = r.status + ' ' + (r.headers.get('content-length') || (await r.text()).length); } catch(e) { out[u] = 'ERR ' + e.message; } } var links=[]; document.querySelectorAll('link[rel=manifest]').forEach(function(l){ links.push(l.href); }); out.manifestLinks = links; return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps.name: 3-manifest
steps.eval: (async function(){ var l = document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]'); if(!l) return JSON.stringify({found:false}); try { var r = await fetch(l.href, {cache:'no-store'}); var j = await r.json(); return JSON.stringify({found:true, status:r.status, name:j.name, shortName:j.short_name, display:j.display, startUrl:j.start_url, themeColor:j.theme_color, icons:(j.icons||[]).length, iconSizes:(j.icons||[]).map(function(i){return i.sizes;})}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({found:true, error:e.message}); } })()

steps.name: 6-offline-state
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({title: document.title, path: location.pathname, nestUI: typeof window.NestUI, uiVer: (window.NestUI||{}).version || null, dark: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), sheets: document.styleSheets.length, bodyBg: getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor, cardBg: (function(){ var c=document.querySelector('.nx-card'); return c ? getComputedStyle(c).backgroundColor : null; })(), bodyText: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,110)})

steps.name: 8-offline-second-page
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({title: document.title, path: location.pathname, nestUI: typeof window.NestUI, sheets: document.styleSheets.length, bodyBg: getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor, bodyText: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,110)})

steps.name: 10-online-check
steps.eval: (async function(){ var r = await fetch('/api/auth/me', {cache:'no-store'}); return JSON.stringify({status:r.status, text:(await r.text()).slice(0,120)}); })()
